why: Fix round, one agent, in next/: CI's `lists only shrink` step is red because this branch edited a row of next-ledger.json. Commit 247fe7dc6 moved the door's page size from ledger/Log.ts to transport/Wire.ts, so the line `import { fromHere, Line, lineFor, PAGE, valueFor } from "../ledger/Log.ts";` in gateway/Gateway.ts lost `PAGE`, and commit 9a67dc36b rewrote main's row to match. The ratchet keys a row on its file, rule and code, so the rewritten row counts as one added. Neither allowed fix fits. Removing the ledger/Log.ts import from the gateway needs a service in processes/ for a named stream, which is open question 1 of docs/plan/layering-debt.md and waits on the owner. Keeping the line as main has it means importing PAGE from the ledger again, which undoes the branch's choice that the door cuts by the wire's page size. No code was changed; the call goes to the lead. One finding row is saved: local `pnpm lint` does not run the ratchet.
note: Ran: ratchet.ts against the merge base, red with the same row as CI. pnpm lint on the two new rows. Not run: tests and typecheck, since no code changed. The start time is approximate, from the first command of the run.
